negative_reviews.author: Sponge
negative_reviews.text:
Service was diabolical, which i dont think was a fault of the junior staff but from poor management. I did note a few individuals who I sussed were management having a bit of an attitude towards their junior staff members.  The food came out in staggered stages. People who had arrived some time after us received the whole of their order before ours was complete.  The ramen was brought out first, luke warm. Ages later the remainder of our order followed. Our stomachs are playing up today and I believe this to be a fault of food temperatures. Was the kicthen understaffed, who knows. I have been to many ramen restaurants and unfortunately this wasnt great.
The toilets were disgusting, clearly not checked throughout the day.

Overall, a poor experience,  which is a shame really.
